request: Enhance Empirical initialization and global agent installation UX. When the empirical-init skill initializes or repairs a repository, present a polished settings wizard before persisting configuration. The wizard must expose evidence policy (required criterion evidence, real-browser checks for UI criteria, UI screenshots, and code review), Git/worktree isolation (mode, base branch, sibling path, and branch pattern), Complex decision records, and any other currently configurable safety settings that belong in setup, while keeping internal Fast/Complex routing hidden. Use safe recommended defaults, explain dependencies between toggles, allow review/edit before confirmation, preserve existing settings during repair, and retain equivalent non-interactive MCP/private-CLI inputs. Replace the current five-row empirical install picker with a searchable, scrollable, polished terminal selector modeled on the current vercel-labs/skills npx CLI experience. Expand global skill-install targets from five agents to the broad audited agent catalog supported by the npx skills ecosystem, including names, ids, native global skill roots, detection hints, and remembered/currently-managed selection. Show detected, installed, and destination-path status; preserve exact --agent, --all, --yes, --json reconciliation and marker/path safety. Keep broad skill-install compatibility separate from executable handoff/MCP capabilities so Empirical never claims it can launch or configure a runtime that only accepts skill files. First produce a reviewable specification and an accurate terminal/conversation mockup; do not implement until the user approves.
message: Archived capability changes: agent-handoff, agent-integrations, decision-traceability, verification-policy, worktree-isolation
